services.name: Tandem Flight
services.desc: Highest rated, most experienced and safest tandem operation in the country. Book your flight today! The price for a tandem flight varies by time of the week, based on demand. To reserve your spot, we collect a $49 deposit per person, which is applied toward your remaining balance due after the flight. If you’d like video of your experience, GoPro cameras are available to rent on the day of your flight for $50.
